summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a 6-K confirming open-market buybacks from 5-9 October 2026 of 150,000 ordinary shares on US trading venues and 48,944 ordinary shares on London venues, executed through Goldman Sachs entities, with all repurchased shares to be cancelled. Trade prices ranged from USD 100.07 to USD 104.62 per share and GBP 75.85 to GBP 78.85 per share. The purchases form part of the EUR 1 billion Programme announced 17 February 2026. Weekly activity details are disclosed under UK MAR Article 5(1)(b). Watch pace versus the EUR 1 billion authorization and any implicit earnings-per-share accretion.
